canh: people at the river wall on Bankside at night, 2026
loi_cau: From Bankside tonight, you can stand roughly where Pepys stood, and look across at the same streets. London burned twice. Twice, it could have started over. Twice, it kept its old streets. And the skyline it built still bends around the one building it chose, again and again, to keep in view.
